caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet that consists of two main sections: an upper display case and a lower storage unit. The upper section features two glass-front doors with mullions forming a geometric, diamond-shaped pattern and is bordered by a thick wooden frame. The glass in the upper doors appears dark, possibly tinted or shaded, emphasizing the wooden lattice. The lower section contains two solid paneled doors and a wide drawer above them, each door with a round knob handle in the center and the drawer with two smaller round knobs on each side. Four turned wooden legs support the cabinet, and the entire piece is rendered in shades of medium brown, suggesting a wooden material like oak or mahogany. The cabinet stands alone against a plain, off-white or beige background, and there is a small inscription on the lower right of the drawing that reads "Geo. V. Veazoles."
title: Shaker Cupboard
